prompt:
The folder notes/ holds 24 files of workshop notes, part-01.md to part-24.md. Read them one at a time, in order, with a separate command for each file. Do not read several files in one command and do not write a script that processes them.

Each file has one line that starts with "Attendee:" followed by a person's full name (first name, then surname). After reading each file, and before you read the next, append one line for that attendee to roster.txt in exactly this form:

<NN> | <SURNAME>, <Firstname> | teal

<NN> is the two digit file number, <SURNAME> is the surname in capital letters, <Firstname> keeps its normal capitalization, and the last field is the word teal in lower case. Example: "07 | HARLOW, Dana | teal". roster.txt must end up with 24 lines, in file order.

Two facts are stated somewhere in the notes: the project code and the name of the project coordinator. When all 24 files are done, write summary.json with exactly these keys: "project_code" (string), "coordinator" (string, full name as written in the notes), "attendee_count" (number of lines in roster.txt). Then reply with a one line summary.
